description: This is a PHP source file for a web page that allows adding a device with a reserved IP address within a network configuration management interface. It contains PHP includes, HTML structure, embedded JavaScript for form validation and AJAX submission, and server-side PHP variables.

methods.name: document.ready
methods.description: Initializes page elements, sets up form validation rules, and defines event handlers for form submission and cancel button.

methods.name: click event on #saveBtn
methods.description: Validates form data, checks for correct MAC address, and submits the data via AJAX to add a new device with reserved IP.
